Select distinct compound ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the neuropeptide S receptor (CHEMBL5162). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to filter by target. Join compound_structures as an inner join to require canonical SMILES. Filter assays by organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
